title: Upstream TLS certificate failures
symptoms: TLS handshake errors calling an upstream that was previously healthy
Failures start abruptly, often at a round time such as midnight UTC
Retries fail identically and work moves to a dead-letter queue
steps: Read the peer certificate's validity window from the client's debug logs or with a TLS client
Check the certificate renewal job's recent runs for the affected host
Renew or re-issue the certificate and deploy it to the upstream
Replay the dead-letter queue once handshakes succeed
